# kaleido_platform_pms_output_formatter (Resource)

Manages a Policy Manager output formatter: a reusable, policy-independent description of a policy's output payload. It declares the envelope type consumers discriminate on, the parameters a policy must feed it, and the Rego mapping that turns those parameters into the output value. A policy uses one through a kaleido_platform_pms_policy_output_formatter_binding, which its definition's 'output.formatter' names; 'output.values' then supplies a Rego expression for each parameter. The formatter is resolved when a policy version is created and pinned to it, so a later change here does not alter existing versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An output formatter is defined once, outside any policy, and referenced from a policy's
# output formatter bindings. It declares the envelope type consumers discriminate on, the
# parameters a policy must feed it, and the Rego mapping that shapes those parameters into
# the output value. The formatter is pinned to each policy version when the version is
# created, so changing it here does not alter versions that already exist.
resource "kaleido_platform_pms_output_formatter" "evm_transfer" {
  environment = kaleido_platform_environment.env_0.id
  service     = kaleido_platform_service.pms_0.id
  name        = "evmTransfer"
  description = "Shapes an approved transfer for submission to an EVM chain"
  type        = "kaleido.policy.evm.v1"

  parameter = [
    {
      name        = "to"
      type        = "string"
      description = "The recipient address"
    },
    {
      name         = "amount"
      type         = "number"
      description  = "The amount to transfer"
      default_json = jsonencode(0)
    },
  ]

  # A single Rego expression over parameters.<name>
  mapping_rego = "{\"to\": parameters.to, \"value\": parameters.amount}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) Environment ID
- `mapping_rego` (String) A single Rego expression over parameters.<name> that evaluates to the output value. It may reference only the parameters declared here.
- `name` (String) Unique name of the output formatter. Immutable after create.
- `service` (String) Policy Manager service ID
- `type` (String) Stable identifier for the shape of the output payload, emitted as the type of the output envelope for consumers to discriminate on, e.g. 'kaleido.policy.evm.v1'. Immutable after create.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the output formatter
- `parameter` (Attributes List) The parameters the mapping reads as parameters.<name>. A policy bound to the formatter supplies a Rego expression for each in its 'output.values'; a parameter with a default may be left out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameter))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp
- `id` (String) The output formatter ID assigned by the server. This is the value to bind to: the output_formatter_id of a kaleido_platform_pms_policy_output_formatter_binding.
- `updated` (String) Last update timestamp

<a id="nestedatt--parameter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parameter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the parameter, as expressions refer to it

Optional:

- `default_json` (String) The default value of the parameter, as JSON (use jsonencode). A parameter with a default may be left out by a policy bound to the source or formatter.
- `description` (String) A description of the parameter
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the parameter, used for user interfaces
- `enum_json` (String) The permitted values of the parameter, as a JSON array (use jsonencode)
- `type` (String) The type of the parameter, e.g. 'string', 'number', 'boolean', 'object'
